notes.title: Editorial UI Principles for Calm Software
notes.contentHtml:
Core Observations

Calm interfaces respect attention by pairing generous cream margins with crisp typographic hierarchy. Avoid unnecessary visual noise.

  • Use consistent semantic accents rather than decorative rainbows.
  • Give long-form writing comfortable line length (65ch).
  • Keep primary actions predictable and grounded.

notes.title: CS-418 Field Observation Synthesis
notes.contentHtml:
Interviewed 6 graduate students about how they organize reading PDFs and lecture notes across semesters.

  • Pain point: Files scattered between downloads folder and cloud tabs.
  • Workaround: Creating manual index docs before finals week.
  • Opportunity: Backlinks between concepts and primary PDFs.

journal.title: Slow Rain, Warm Tea, and Quiet Focus
journal.contentHtml:
Spent the morning by the window organizing my autumn study plan. Turning off notifications for three hours completely changed how calmly I moved through my reading list.

Small reminder to myself: pace matters more than urgency.
